reviews.text: We switched to Metrotech for pool service about 9 months ago. Metrotech deserves the highest rating we can give. You can tell when someone cares about the quality of service and solution provided. Ken and other representatives have taken extra effort with our pool service. They communicate very well. We have worked with other pool services for over 10 years. Metrotech is resoundingly a huge upgrade for us. Thank you Metrotech for the top quality service!

We had a major pool filter leak which shut down our pool.  They responded immediately, were out there the next morning, gave us a fair estimate to replace our leaking filter system and had it done in just a few hours.  Very professional and very knowledgeable about pool repairs. Took time to look over other elements of our pool system such as the heater and plaster and give us advice (plaster good for another few years,  heater -get gas company to put in larger meter) that did not benefit them.

I really appreciate Ken answering the phone and helping me early Monday morning 2/15 at 7:30am as my pool was in the later stages of freezing over and struggling to operate.  I called 5 companies that morning in a panic trying to figure out how to drain my equipment properly.  Ken answered, literally walked me through the process over the phone.  He was very calm and patient and detailed, he took much longer time explaining things than I would have given myself lol. We must of been on the phone

Rick, Amy, Alex--and all the folks at Metrotech pools have been just excellent to work with.
I live in a rental, and limped the pool through the first summer here, failing as I went.  The pool, I thought, was close to beyond repair.
Alex came out, assessed the pool, and recommended a plan to get the pool up and running again.  Two weeks later--my pool is now sparkling clean, and operating as it should.  Along the way, faults were discovered, and fixed.  I can now enjoy the pool knowing it's in g

We've been using Metrotech Pool Service for about 2 years. They are always there each week for the cleaning and they keep track of when the filters are supposed to be cleaned next and they show up and do it. At one point the technician who usually tends our pool was out with Covid. Instead of us missing a week of cleaning they sent a different technician to make sure it got done. Great customer service!

We had them come out and replace a pool light ($950) that was faulty. They stated that it would work and we would take "full advantage" of the upgraded light. After installation we fine out that it does not work %100 with our older system, so thanks for misleading us on the upgraded light.

They determined that our GFCI switch by the pool equipment was faulty as well, replaced that and charged us for it ($75). The pool light never worked and so they recommended we reach out to an electrician.

After calling literally 6 other pool companies, this is the first company to come out and diagnose my leak. Alex was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and willing to explain the issue in a way that I could understand. They are also much more reasonably priced than any other pool repair company I’ve come across. They’ll will now be my go-to.

Absolute worst customer service.  Ken constantly sets appointments but Alex  does not show up.  Even when he does show up, they do not complete the work the first time.  Alex is awesome.  Knows his stuff.  What is not awesome is taking off work for a no show with no phone call appointment on Monday, then being told Tuesday it would be first thing Thursday.  No show, no phone call Thursday morning.  Phone call Thursday afternoon that it may be Friday. After they rescheduled  again, I called  to c

Ken's service has been outstanding and is a very honest and genuine person. He installed a brand Jandy pool heater at a cost that no other swimming pool company could compete. He always answers his calls and is  very helpful with any questions that one might have.

I contacted their lawn sprinkler division both by email on their website and left a voice mail for them to come out and quote on sprinkler repair. Never heard from them. And the Home Advisor group that endorses them is ridiculous too.  Terrible not even responding. Will never use them. Plus I found someone who came out the next day and didn't charge a "trip charge" like Metrotech does.

I AM VERY HAPPY  CUSTOMER.
The company provides excellent service and charge fair price for changing a part on pool pump they show up on Christmas Eve and resolve the issue very profession.
Highly recommended Metrotech pool service company.

Excellent Company- very knowledgeable team.

We worked with Alex specifically and he was great. Went above and beyond the specific issue we called for- saw other issues that he told us about and spent time to educate us and point us in the right direction.

We will definitely be reaching out to them in the future when needed!

Thank you for all your help!

BEWARE:  I cancelled my service with this company more than a month ago and was told I would be refunded for a partial month's payment.  They never processed the refund, and one month later they debited my credit card again!! I have left a phone message every single day for a week, with no response.

I did not care for the job  but Ken was more then obliging and cooperated in the long run. Ken refunded 500 dollars of my money and my husband is going to fix the sharp edges on the top. Ken has been kind since we got past the first few weeks.
Awful. They've let Our pool go green again. And they were asked to do a simple light repair over a month ago and still didn't. They are almost impossible to reach
